data.text:
Shobitha.B vs The Authorized Officer on 22 October, 2024 
Author: D K Singh
Bench: D. K. Singh
Wp(C) No.37066/2024 1/3 Order Date : 22-10-20
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice D. K. Singh
 Tuesday, the 22nd day of October 2024 / 30th Aswina, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 37066 Of 2024
 Petitioner:
 Shobitha.B, Aged 40 Years, W/O. Shijinas.T, Kottakuzhiyil Veedu,
 Ayanivelikulangara, Alumkadavu.P.O, Karunagappally, Kollam District,
 Pin-690573.
 Respondents:
 1. The Authorized Officer, Repco Home Finance Ltd., Tc. No. 20/2381,
 Nihal Complex, Ground Floor, Karamana.P.O, Thiruvananthapuram,
 Pin-695005
 2.  THE BRANCH MANAGER, REPCO HOME FINANCE LTD., KOLLAM BRANCH, 1ST  FLOOR,KRISHNASWAMY AVENUE, CONVENT ROAD, BEHIND DISTRICT HOSPITAL,
 KOLLAM DISTRICT, PIN-691001  Writ Petition (Civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay all other further proceedings pursuant to Ext.P4 and P5,
 pending disposal of this writ petition.
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  M/S. BINU GEORGE & HEMALATHA, Advocates for the petitioner, the court  passed the following:
 WP(C) No.37066/2024 2/3 Order Date : 22-1  D K SINGH, J.
 ------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C) No. 37066 of 2024  ------------------------------------------
 Dated: 22nd October 2024  ORDER Shobitha.B vs The Authorized Officer on 22 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35787812/
1 Issue notice to respondents by usual mode as well as speed post, for which steps are to be taken within two days. 
Post the matter on 05.11.2024 along with the service report. 
Subject to the petitioner making payment of Rs.2 lakhs on or before 04.11.2024, the petitioner shall not be dispossessed from the secured asset till the next date of posting. 
Sd/-
D K SINGH JUDGE jjj WP(C) No.37066/2024 3/3 Order Date : 22-10-2024 APPENDIX OF WP(C)
37066/2024 Exhibit P1 A TRUE COPY OF REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE DATED 22.09.2020 ISSUED BY COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY Exhibit P2 A TRUE COPY OF DEATH CERTIFICATE OF PETITIONER'S FATHER DATED 21.10.2024 ISSUED BY KARUNAGAPPALLY MUNICIPALITY Exhibit P3 A TRUE COPY OF DISCHARGE SUMMARY OF PETITIONER'S DAUGHTER DATED 14.12.2013 ISSUED FROM BISHOP BENZIGER HOSPITAL Exhibit P4 A TRUE COPY OF POSSESSION NOTICE DATED 14.02.2023 ISSUED BY THE RESPONDENT BANK Exhibit P5 A TRUE COPY OF NOTICE ISSUED BY ADVOCATE COMMISSIONER DATED 08.10.2024 Shobitha.B vs The Authorized Officer on 22 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35787812/
2
